set_default_style: set the default imgui style with a dark color scheme, custom spacing, and scrollbar size
grayed_out_context_manager: use the grayed_out context manager to disable and gray out imgui UI elements conditionally
button_with_enabled: create an imgui button that supports an enabled flag to gray out and disable clicks
collapsing_header_with_flags: build a collapsible header section with optional default open, enabled, and visibility flags
drag_button_with_delta: create a draggable imgui button that returns click state, drag state, and mouse drag delta
